scope: Read all 30 complete question/options/trace/answer renderings and their first_seen, instances, geometry_values, and frame_n_share evidence; full JSON rows are printed in READ30.md, with remaining metadata checked by verify_rows.py.
findings: Every object has the correct visibility statement for the 0.002 floor.
Every out-of-view object cites the latest recorded frame before k or a disclosed nearest later reference.
Every per-object relation and final answer agree with the geometry evidence and lettered options.
The sample includes all-in-view, all-out-of-view, mixed, and future-reference cases in each family.
The sample includes both semantic directions in each pair family and latest-first-seen winners in each camera family.
All references use indices in 1..32 and say of 32 at the first mention.
Object-labelled subjects preserve grammatical agreement for plural category labels. Source label spellings, including fire exinguisher, are preserved.
